Hitch a train to a driver train. The hitched train is emptied of pax and removed from the sim, while its cars are appended to the driver. The order parameter (from -1000 to 1000) determines the hitched train cars position: the driver train is always order 0, so negative values will put the hitch in front of the driver, and positive values behind it.
